title: dubrueilia verbascifolia
intro: Dubrueilia verbascifolia, commonly known as Verbascum thapsus or Mullein, is a biennial plant species in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum thapsus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant has been used to treat a range of health issues, including insomnia, ear infections, and skin conditions, and its leaves and flowers have been used in herbal remedies for centuries.
